threepl.parser

Interface Version


  • public interface Version
    Compiler version information. `version' is a string containing the global compiler version - this is in the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, where MAJOR, MINOR and PATCH are positive integers (conforms to Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 - see https://semver.org/). the version number is retrieved by sourcing topdir/version (make or shell) `revision` is a string containing subversion revision information created by running `svnversion topdir /3pl/branch' - where branch could be either /trunk or /branches/mjj-release (depends on where we are working from). if this string contains anything other than digits (e.g. ":", "M", or "S") then the compiler was not built with a clean checked-in tree. i.e. it was not fully updated, there were local modifications, or it does not match the branch above (aka switched). topdir is the path to the root of the subversion working copy, usually something like ../../..
